entries.0e4d9ff16a8f45cd: The company’s group companies and others
entries.1ca90f823bb644e1: It manufactures and sells machine tools such as transfer machines and NC machine tools, and inspection and measuring equipment such as wire saws, microfinishers and leak test machines. A subsidiary in China handles sales and service for wire saws and inspection and measuring equipment. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥2,791 million.
entries.1e042309095c2e09: This is a manufacturer headquartered in Iga, Mie Prefecture, which forms a group with the company and 9 consolidated subsidiaries. It has 3 reportable segments (engine parts, machinery equipment and environmental equipment) and also operates a transportation and service business. The consolidated number of employees in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was 1,706.
entries.2203470ed2305d7d: It manufactures and sells various air pumps for septic tanks, medical and health equipment, fuel cells, live fish transport and ornamental fish, as well as garbage disposer systems.
entries.41c442245684d116: This business is not included in the reportable segments; it operates a transport business that transports and packs engine parts and similar items, and a service business providing building maintenance, factory cleaning and staff catering. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥265 million.
entries.46a5c93dfbd803eb: Manufacturers of septic tanks, medical and health equipment and others
entries.5166d96145a0d19f: It manufactures and sells automotive engine parts such as connecting rods, cylinder heads, cylinder blocks, camshafts and crankshafts, and micro-shape processed products such as wick sheets for vapor chambers for smartphones. The company manufactures and sells in Japan; subsidiaries in Indonesia, Thailand and Mexico manufacture and sell, and a subsidiary in the United States handles sales. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥25,721 million.
